part.label: Fully Rounded Electronics Case
part.description: A small electronics enclosure body with every edge rounded (a full 3D round-over, like a soap bar) via a bounded `fillet` feature's `edges: "all"` -- brepjs's real `edgeFinder().findAll()`, matched exactly against a hand-derived Minkowski-sum volume formula (core box plus edge quarter-cylinders plus corner octant-spheres) for the box alone before the vent hole is cut.

components.description: 50x35x18mm case body, every edge rounded to a 3mm radius.

features.description: Full 3D round-over on every edge, not just the vertical corners.
A single vent hole through the rounded top.
